content.title: About
content.content: Fruit juice diet drink is a non‑alcoholic refreshing beverage made from concentrated fruit juices, sweetened with low‑calorie sweeteners, and fortified with vitamins. It is designed for people who watch their calorie intake but do not want to give up the taste of fruit.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Diet fruit drinks often use stevia or sucralose instead of sugar.
Most brands add vitamin C to enhance flavor and antioxidant properties.
The drink may contain up to 30 % real fruit juice, the rest being water and flavorings.
Some versions are enriched with probiotics to support gut microbiota.
In many markets these drinks are sold in 0.5 L and 1 L bottles.

items.title: Low Calorie
items.content: A typical 250 ml serving contains only 30–50 kcal, making it suitable for a diet menu.

items.title: Vitamin Complex
items.content: Fortified with vitamin C, vitamin B6 and folate, the drink supports immunity and metabolism.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: With more than 90 % water content, it helps maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Fruit extracts and vitamin C provide antioxidant activity, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Digestive Support
items.content: Some variants contain fruit pectin fibers that aid normal gastrointestinal function.

items.title: Fruit Allergy
items.content: People allergic to specific fruits (e.g., citrus) may experience reactions.

items.title: Artificial Sweeteners
items.content: Sensitivity to stevia or sucralose can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in some individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may contribute to tooth enamel erosion with frequent consumption.

items.title: Sodium Content
items.content: Some brands add a small amount of salt for taste; those with hypertension should check the label.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve chilled, optionally with ice or fresh fruit slices. It works as a substitute for sugary sodas, a refreshing snack between meals, or a post‑workout beverage.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
